scope: Qualitative exterior revision for game use. Fixed studio camera positions/lenses retained from baseline; not calibrated OEM silhouette metrology. No exterior-to-interior release requested.
reviewerMode: primary visual inspection plus independent native file readback

front.finding: Neutral-black side glazing, reduced front lens size, sculpted nose corner returns and exposed silver aero sectors visible. The studio softbox is still reflected on the windshield.

side.finding: Rear glazing ends earlier and the white C-pillar/rear shoulder is broader; wheel centers and overall side shell retained.

rear.finding: Black rear glass, wide flush upper aero panel and recessed carbon lower fascia; external fan row removed.

wing.finding: Full-width panel rotates about a front hinge, with visible connected struts beneath it; no tall lift-only stanchions.

remainingLimits: Photo-guided exterior proportions rather than measured OEM CAD
Cabin internals and complete self-intersection certification are not included

browserReview.showroomMotion: Four actual vertex-sampled actions passed after isolating each case at t=0. Earlier mid-animation initialization failure retained in evidence/roadster-blackglass-showroom-mid-animation-check.json.
browserReview.standaloneConsole: No warnings/errors on independent homepage and star-ring run. Iframe dashboard navigation had a separate MutationObserver null-Node exception, recorded in browser report.
